description: power-platform plugin gates, each scoped to the surfaces it names (references/rules-and-scope.md). Before tools: design before canvas screens, plan before a table deploy, flow lint before a solution import. At stop: a canvas, Power Pages or Power BI build needs its design record, critique and review (the 30/40 floor and the review topics for Power Pages only); no access token written to storage (any build, Fabric most often); in any Power Platform project, no background work still running, no question with no person present, and test writes proven back. After shell calls: the call count and elapsed time. After a .pa.yaml write: the compile-killer check, unless the project's own harness runs it. Silent in folders that are not Power Platform projects.
